title: SMOOTH FIRST SWING PILOT
description: The change is pitched as onboarding, but it quietly rewires what the team thinks a beginner is worth. The opening combat pass now lets attacks cancel cleanly into dodge, loot pickup, and the inevitable tutorial popover. The upgrade flow now presents higher-value bundles at the exact moment players run out of patience.
consequence: Players blamed themselves for failure instead of the input queue, which design marked as a milestone. The economy found the pause between frustration and quitting.
